records.independent_evidence: For V>0 and separated front/rear events, the transformation adds a nonzero positive position term even though Delta t'=0. Treating simultaneity as frame-independent deletes that term.
records.author_derivation_compared_after_FIRST: The nonzero spatial term survives even though Delta t'=0. Since the events are separated along a nonzero train velocity, their ground event times differ.
